concerns.text: SC-001 only states that `review_effort_duration` is measured against a baseline, but provides no pass/fail threshold or quantitative condition that can be checked. A success criterion must define a measurable outcome (e.g., a minimum effect size, a required reduction/increase, or a confidence interval) to be testable.

SC-003 describes measuring effect size against standard benchmarks (small, medium, large) but does not specify which benchmark must be achieved or any quantitative target. Without a concrete threshold, this criterion cannot be objectively verified.
